verdicts.reason: Both put the design into a small dark strip on a mostly blank white banner and lose almost all of the original. A crops the headline to fragments ('T IN' / 'ORY') at an oversized scale, cuts off a stray letter and drops the date, address and offer entirely. B also clips 'OPEN NIGHT IN' and 'FREE ENTRY FO' and squashes the observatory into a corner, but at least part of the headline and the offer can still be read.
